prompt: How long does a full car detail take?
engine: Gemini (gemini.google.com, logged out, site storage cleared before the prompt)
answer:
Gemini said

A standard full car detail (which includes a comprehensive cleaning of both the interior and exterior) typically takes anywhere from 3 to 6 hours.   
L&M Pro Car Detailing

However, the exact time can vary quite a bit depending on a few key factors:

Breakdown by Service Type

Full Detail (Interior + Exterior): 3 to 6 hours (Standard maintenance clean, wash, wax, vacuum, and wipe down).   
L&M Pro Car Detailing

Interior-Only Detail: 1.5 to 3 hours (Deep vacuuming, shampooing carpets/seats, cleaning dashboard and glass).   
L&M Pro Car Detailing

Exterior-Only Detail: 1.5 to 3 hours (Hand wash, wheel cleaning, clay bar decontamination, and sealant or wax application).   
BGI Pro Auto Detailing

With Paint Correction or Coatings: 6 to 12+ hours (or even multiple days) if you are adding multi-stage paint polishing, scratch removal, or a ceramic coating.   
BGI Pro Auto Detailing

What Factors Change the Time?

Vehicle Size: A compact coupe or sedan will be on the faster end (around 3 to 4 hours), while a large three-row SUV, van, or large pickup truck can easily take 5 to 7+ hours due to the extra surface area and interior volume.   
Autotrader

Current Condition: If the car has heavily embedded pet hair, sand, mud, severe stains, stubborn odors, or exterior tree sap and road tar, expect the job to take toward the longer end of the spectrum (or require an all-day booking).   
L&M Pro Car Detailing

Crew Size: A professional shop working with a team of two or more people might knock a full detail out closer to 3 hours, whereas a solo detailer will take longer.   
BGI Pro Auto Detailing

If you are planning to drop your car off at a detail shop, it is usually safest to plan to leave it with them for most of the day.   
BGI Pro Auto Detailing
